name: core
title: core
summary: Shared compose and runtime directives for Mesh `@link` family core/v0.1.
stamp: Import with `@link(url: "https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/core/v0.1", import: [...])`. Import `@transport` from this same URL whenever a schema needs it (you can `@link` other family URLs alongside it).
notes: Mesh stitching `@source` uses `subgraph:` (and optional `type:`). HTTP/REST Connectors `@source` uses `http:` and lives under specs.apollo.dev/connect.
PubSub directives are published under https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/pubsub/v0.1 (not on this core page).

`@merge` is legacy back-compat only and is not published on this family page. New entity-resolution annotations use Federation Spec `@lookup` / `@is` / `@internal` via https://graphql.github.io/graphql-federation-spec/draft (not published here).
Validation: Mesh `@link` family URLs must use supported versions (`v0.1`). `@transport` is SCHEMA-only; `kind` required; `@hoist.pathConfig` must be an array when present.

name: pubsub
title: pubsub
summary: PubSub subscription and publish field directives for topic and webhook bindings (EDFS).
notes: Import `@pubsubOperation` and `@pubsubPublish` from this family URL.

name: sql
title: sql
summary: SQL table mapping directive for GraphQL fields and types backed by SQL.

name: thrift
title: thrift
summary: Binary Thrift RPC field mapping directive.
notes: Pair with `@transport` from core/v0.1. JSON Thrift uses Connectors `@connect` instead.

name: mongo
title: mongo
summary: MongoDB operation binders for GraphQL fields.

name: neo4j
title: neo4j
summary: Neo4j graph model directives with optional subgraph attribution.
notes: Optional `subgraph:` attributes multi-source ownership in composition; it is not a graph-store label.

name: auth
title: auth
summary: Auth exemption directive used with complete-protection auth policies.

name: rate-limit
title: rate-limit
notes: A conforming gateway must enforce these annotations; without an enforcer they have no effect.
